profile: softmax cost function: A cost function for multi-class classification, also referred to as cross entropy cost. It is minimized when training linear multi-class classifiers, and a two-class version can be used to learn a separator. The multi-class softmax cost averages a log-sum-exp term minus the linear response of the true class over data points; the two-class softmax cost has the form Σ log(1 + e^{-y_p(b + f_p^T ω)}). It is also among the cost functions used in feature learning.
